## Claim discipline

State which outputs are observed, derived, inferred, modeled, counterfactual, or unknown.
Do not present model output as observation or graph propagation as empirical causal proof.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and related issue/design is linked.
- [ ] Contracts, implementation, fixtures, tests, and docs are aligned where applicable.
- [ ] Tests cover normal, boundary, invalid-input, and regression behavior.
- [ ] Deterministic generated cases are seeded and replayable.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or unlicensed datasets are included.
- [ ] Generated files, lockfiles, and manifest changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Required checks are green on the exact proposed head commit.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] Any self-review is identified as self-review, not independent approval.

## Remaining work

List deferred work, unsupported cases, risks, and follow-up issues. Write "None" only when
there is genuinely no known follow-up.
